name: Cult Food Science
summary: Cult Food Science Corp. operates as a venture capital firm, dedicating its capital investments to companies across various stages within the food sectors. Its investment strategy covers the full spectrum, from initial incubation and seed funding, through early and mid-stage ventures, to late-stage, emerging growth, and established growth capital opportunities. Currently, the company does not manage significant direct business operations. Instead, its strategic focus is on acquiring or participating in new assets and enterprises. Established in 1983, the entity now known as Cult Food Science Corp. was formerly named Triangle Industries Ltd. and adopted its current name in July 2021. In its previous incarnation, the company provided freight, reloading, and warehousing services. Cult Food Science Corp. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada, and also maintains an office in Vancouver, Canada.
